$comment: Trusted receiver factory allowlist, read from the PR base ref only. Only receipts whose audited definition.json digest (the factory identity `apmx audit` reports as facts.definitionSha256) appears here are accepted. This is receiver policy evaluated after, and independently of, `apmx audit` validity or signing; see receiver/receipt_policy.py. The listed digest binds the exact check commands and dependency paths of the canonical receipt, so regenerate and re-approve it from that receipt at activation.
